faq_heading: Homes near Henry Bose Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Henry Bose Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Henry Bose Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Henry Bose Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Henry Bose Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary (0.4 km south-west), St Bernadette (0.6 km west) and North Ridge Elementary (0.7 km south).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Henry Bose Elementary

29 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Henry Bose Elementary in a straight line (21 elementary, 6 secondary, 2 other; 6 independent). The closest is Ecole Panorama Ridge Secondary, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Frank Hurt Secondary, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is St Bernadette (0.6 km); the nearest independent school is St Bernadette (0.6 km). Other elementary schools close by: St Bernadette (0.6 km west), North Ridge Elementary (0.7 km south), Martha Jane Norris Elementary (1.0 km west), W E Kinvig Elementary (1.1 km north), Hyland Elementary (1.2 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is St Bernadette, 0.6 km west of Henry Bose Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Henry Bose Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Henry Bose Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Henry Bose Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at St Bernadette, the nearest other elementary school, 0.6 km west of Henry Bose Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
